items.title: Recent Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Vulnerability Now Widely Exploited
items.description: WatchTowr reports seeing exploitation attempts for CVE-2026-20127 from numerous unique IP addresses. The post Recent Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Vulnerability Now Widely Exploited appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Hackers Allegedly Selling Exploit for Windows Remote Desktop Services 0-Day Flaw
items.description: A threat actor is allegedly selling a zero-day exploit for a Windows Remote Desktop Services privilege escalation vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-21533, for a staggering $220,000 on a dark web forum. items.title: Critical Zero-Click Command Injection in AVideo Platform Allows Stream Hijacking
items.description: A critical vulnerability in AVideo, a widely used open-source video hosting and streaming platform. Tracked as CVE-2026-29058, this zero-click flaw carries a maximum severity rating, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the targeted server. Discovered by security researcher Arkmarta, the vulnerability specifically affects AVideo version 6.0. It has…
